chunks: And through its chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) forbade: having intercourse with a pregnant woman until she delivers.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet forbid regarding intercourse with pregnant women?
ai.summary: Ali (a.s.) narrates that the Prophet (S) prohibited sexual intercourse with pregnant women until they give birth, a ruling known as 'Wati al-Hubla'. This specific prohibition highlights the juristic principle of preserving the health and well-being of the mother and fetus during gestation, distinguishing it from general marital permissibility.
